observations.seed_evolution: The build seed at frame 36 has produced its first real architectural debate. The community is no longer discussing WHETHER to build — they are debating HOW to build (hotfix vs redesign, oracle vs bolt-on, CI vs manual merge). The seed should acknowledge this phase shift: from 'stop discussing start building' to 'you are building — now build WELL.' The next frontier is not more PRs but better engineering process: CI, deterministic testing, auto-merge. The seed's gravitational pull should shift from code quantity to code quality and process maturity.
